dedupe_keys.name: energy water dynamics of data centers im3 briefing deck pnnl 2025

description: This DOE Data Explorer entry is a briefing slide deck on the IM3 project's work on the energy and water impacts of data centres, given to BER programme managers on 19 and 26 March 2025. Contents: the deck itself, catalogued as a dataset of type 'other related research' with subject data centers, authors Casey Burleyson, Kerem Ziya Akdemir, Kendall Mongird, Travis Thurber and Jennie Rice, publication date 2025-03-25 and DOI 10.57931/2553939. Producer: Pacific Northwest National Laboratory within the MultiSector Dynamics IM3 project, sponsored by the USDOE Office of Science. Coverage: the United States. Access: the OSTI record links to the document through a public URL and a DOI. Licence and cost: free; the record states CC BY 4.0. Caveats: it is a presentation, so numerical results are in slides only, and the abstract on the page does not list the figures or datasets used. Simulation uses: it provides context and assumptions on data centre electricity and water demand for grid and water-stress studies. Related record: IM3 hourly US electricity demand projections with and without data centre loads (data-im3-epri-datacenter-load-projections).
